name: Spider Room
summary: The Genie spider in your room, in augmented reality on the iPhone. It climbs walls, leaps onto tables, naps on seats, knocks on doors and spins webs. Pick it up and throw it: it sticks where it lands. Camera frames stay on the phone.

screenshots.alt: The Spider Room page on an iPhone: the camera shows a living room, the Genie spider climbs the wall beside a window with a web next to it, and a speech bubble says Wall climbing

license.terms: Included under the ForkMesh repository licence.

permissions.label: Use the camera to find the floor, walls and furniture; frames stay on this phone and are never saved or sent
Track how the phone moves so the spider stays put on the surface it is on
